history.question: How it all started
answer: The MOMENTO journey was born from a passion for exceptional desserts and ice creams.
Driven by the desire to combine tradition and creativity, we began with a simple idea: to turn every bite into a memorable moment.
Over time, we have refined our recipes and techniques to offer creations that reflect our love for detail and our pursuit of excellence.

partnership.question: Our partnership approach
answer: MOMENTO is an artisanal brand, deeply committed to quality and the coherence of its universe. For this reason, we carefully select our partners.
We prioritize establishments that share our values, our high standards of quality, and our focus on customer experience.

ingredients.question: Our ingredients
answer: We place great importance on the selection of ingredients, favoring quality, authenticity, and respect for our recipes.
Each creation is designed to offer a perfect balance of flavors, textures, and indulgence, without compromising on standards.

events.question: Orders and events
answer: MOMENTO also supports special moments through dedicated orders for professional or private events.
For any specific request, we invite you to contact us so we can explore the possibilities together based on your needs.

locations.question: Where to find MOMENTO
answer: MOMENTO creations are available through our selected partners and points of sale.
We are gradually expanding our presence to ensure consistent quality and an experience that remains true to the brand’s universe.

speculoosSaltedCaramel.name: Spéculoos Salted Caramel
speculoosSaltedCaramel.description: Creamy, salted caramel with a speculoos crunch. A sweet and salty pot for those who love a little contrast.
speculoosSaltedCaramel.quote: A pinch of salt in the caramel, and the speculoos sings a little louder. That is the whole secret.

speculoos.name: Spéculoos
speculoos.description: Smooth and biscuity. A comforting classic for anyone who loves the speculoos flavour.
speculoos.quote: Some flavours remind you of home. Speculoos is one of them, so I never rush it.

tiramisuClassique.name: Tiramisu Classique
tiramisuClassique.description: The timeless tiramisu, made the traditional way and served in a pot you can take anywhere.
tiramisuClassique.quote: Coffee, mascarpone, patience. I did not change a thing, and I never will.

oreo.name: Oreo
oreo.description: Creamy and crunchy. A playful pot for biscuit lovers.
oreo.quote: I wanted to see what happens when cream meets a biscuit. Now nobody wants it to end.

snickers.name: Snickers
snickers.description: Caramel, chocolate and peanuts together in one generous pot.
snickers.quote: Caramel, chocolate, peanuts. Why choose one when the spoon can find all three?

pistache.name: Pistache
pistache.description: Smooth and nutty, with the delicate flavour of pistachio.
pistache.quote: Pistachio needs a gentle hand. Too much and it shouts; just enough and it whispers.

bueno.name: Bueno
bueno.description: Creamy and chocolatey. Soft, indulgent and easy to love.
bueno.quote: Hazelnut, chocolate and a cloud of cream. I tasted it three times, just to be sure.

citron.name: Citron
citron.description: Fresh and zesty. A light, bright pot for a fresh finish.
citron.quote: After a good meal, a little lemon. It wakes up the spoon and the smile.

mangue.name: Mangue
mangue.description: Fruity and sunny. A taste of the sun in every spoonful.

framboise.name: Framboise

redVelvet.name: Red Velvet
redVelvet.description: Soft and velvety. A smooth, elegant dessert with a gentle sweetness.

mousseAuChocolat.name: Mousse au Chocolat

mousseAuChocolat.quote: A good mousse is mostly air and patience. The chocolate does the rest.

a: Momento started in a kitchen, with two chefs and one question: how can we make desserts easier to enjoy, without losing the care of homemade pastry? The answer was the pot: individual, generous and easy to take anywhere.
Marcelo is the experienced pastry chef, Milo the young creative chef. They are the two characters of the Momento world: you can follow their adventures, season after season, on Instagram and TikTok.
We place great importance on the selection of ingredients, favouring quality, authenticity and respect for our recipes.
Each creation is designed to offer a fine balance of flavours, textures and indulgence.
Momento creations are available through our partners in Belgium. [List of points of sale to be confirmed]
